row: Rob Robertson is a Registered Massage Therapist (RMQ #M-2915) and owner of The Paw Spa Ottawa-Gatineau K9 Solutions, serving clients in Ontario and Quebec, Canada. He provides massage and teaches canine (K9/dog) and human massage internationally via Udemy, reaching 500+ students in 40+ countries, including the US, Canada, UK, and Australia. Rob completed 2,678 hours of advanced training, including Deep Tissue, Ashiatsu, Pranic Healing, IFC/TENS, and K9 Massage, and was formerly registered with CMTO (2007–2020). He carries full professional liability insurance, is a Blue Cross provider, and offers retail wellness products. Rob delivers customized treatments integrating Myofascial Release, Trigger Point Therapy, Deep Tissue, Ashiatsu, Chakra/Energy Work, and rehabilitative exercises to reduce pain, stress, anxiety, fatigue, migraines, and repetitive strain injuries while improving mobility, flexibility, function, and overall wellness. Contact Rob @itsHealing
